**zathura** is a highly customizable, keyboard-driven document viewer, running natively on your jailbroken device through the X11-on-iOS stack.

This is a real native arm64 binary cross-compiled for rootless iOS, built on GTK3 and the girara interface library. With the bundled poppler plugin it opens PDF files and drives them entirely from the keyboard.

- Keyboard-first navigation in the vi tradition
- PDF rendering through the poppler plugin
- Search, links, bookmarks, and a fit-to-page view
- Light and dark recoloring for comfortable reading

Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`). Install `zathura-pdf-poppler` for PDF support, which this repo also ships.
